summary: All 13 selected items are distinct, timely, and worth keeping. Two multi-item clusters are same-event/distinct-angle rather than redundant: the AI pacing petition (OpenAI position, Anthropic endorsement, origin/signatories) and the Hugging Face autonomous-agent incident (Altman's training-pause remarks and the defender-side technical replay). AnthropicAI and OpenAI each appear twice but on separate topics, so no single author dominates. The DeepMind/AlphaFold item is a second-hand relay of Financial Times reporting via a low-reach account and is flagged for source traceability, though the digest can only re-verify via Twitter search, not the web. No hard duplicates require replacement.
